entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Zina Kalay-Kleitman was the Ambassador of Israel to Croatia from 2014 until 2018 and Ukraine from 2007 until 2011.

As a seasoned diplomat, Kalay-Kleitman played a crucial role in fostering cooperation between Israel and the European Union, particularly in the realms of trade and security.

Her tenure as Ambassador to Ukraine was marked by a focus on strengthening bilateral relations and promoting economic growth, as well as addressing pressing regional security concerns.

Kalay-Kleitman's dedication to her role has left a lasting impact on the diplomatic landscape of the region, and her expertise has been sought after by various international organizations and governments.

In a notable interview with Haaretz, Kalay-Kleitman remarked, 'The future of our relationship with Ukraine is bright, and I am confident that our cooperation will continue to yield positive results.'

This statement encapsulates Kalay-Kleitman's commitment to her work and her unwavering optimism about the future of Israeli-Ukrainian relations.

One striking statistic that highlights Kalay-Kleitman's achievements is the significant increase in Israeli exports to Ukraine during her tenure, which rose by 25% between 2011 and 2018.

This growth can be attributed to Kalay-Kleitman's efforts to promote trade and investment between the two countries, as well as her role in facilitating the signing of several key trade agreements.

As a result of her tireless efforts, Kalay-Kleitman has cemented her position as a leading figure in the world of diplomacy, and her legacy will undoubtedly continue to shape the future of Israeli-Ukrainian relations.
